payload.title: Document sign-in, Accounts and enrollment on p.apyr.us; consolidate docs/cli-login.md
payload.description:
Repo: **Papyrus-web** (p.apyr.us) and Papyrus `docs/`. Closing task of the enrollment epic.

## Deliverables
1. p.apyr.us feature page "Sign in and Accounts": Google sign-in only (no passwords, ever), what an Account is ("Account", never "Organization"), one Account or several, how the console and the CLI choose one, what enrollment means for a person (one Google identity across Anthus products through Prospectus), what the site may and may not do with Prospectus (no account creation until kanbus-dbc30a, no memberships until kanbus-2823b5; update as they land).
2. How-To items: `howto-sign-in-from-the-cli` (`papyrus login`, `--remote`, `whoami`, `account use`), `howto-choose-an-account-in-the-console`, `howto-fix-run-papyrus-login-again` (reenrollment_required explained).
3. Papyrus `docs/cli-login.md` consolidated (which client, enrollment, accounts, authorization, whoami, alarms from PPY-45efff); `docs/site-hosting.md` gains the `consoleOrigin` and the `/cli/*` routes on the console host (from PPY-d8b616).
4. Published through the CMS publish path; URLs recorded here. No ids or emails. Blocked by every ready-now task of the epic (the WAIT parts are documented as "coming" with their Prospectus ids).
